intro: Converting kilowatt-hours (kWh) to joules (J) is essential when translating measurements across household electricity billing, HVAC thermal sizing, battery storage capacity, and dietary energy analysis. One kilowatt-hour equals 3,600,000 joules, while one joule equals 2.777778e-7 kilowatt-hours. Whether you are verifying specifications on technical drawings, reconciling international supplier data sheets, or checking everyday measurements, this calculator applies the exact NIST and BIPM conversion factor with instant table lookups and step-by-step worked examples.

faqs.question: How many joules are in 1 kilowatt-hour?
faqs.answer: There are 3,600,000 joules (J) in 1 kilowatt-hour (kWh). To convert kWh to J, use the exact conversion factor 3,600,000.

faqs.question: How do I convert kilowatt-hours to joules manually?
faqs.answer: Multiply your kilowatt-hour value by 3,600,000 (exact factor: 3,600,000). For example, 250 kWh × 3,600,000 = 900,000,000 J.
